note: Drive Like a Local: Florida (GTA 6 tie-in). US federal MUTCD signs, which Florida uses with state supplements. NO TITLE IS CONFIRMED: Wikimedia Commons could not be reached from the agent workspace (2026-10-26), so every entry is a 'search' entry. fetch_signs.py accepts a file whose title starts with the search text followed by a space, a comma or .svg (for example 'File:MUTCD R10-6.svg'), skips the words it avoids, and prefers the shortest title. The first runner run writes DISCOVER.txt for the queries below: replace each 'search' with the exact 'title' from it, then bump rev. Licences are NOT assumed: the runner copies the licence of each file page into sources.json and SOURCES.md; the video descriptions name Wikimedia Commons and say unaltered, nothing more, until those files are read. MUTCD designations are given as the sign's number; 'need' states what each sign must show so a wrong match is visible at once. Used by the five episodes: R10-6 (episode gta6_fl_red_light), S3-1 (gta6_fl_school_bus), R2-1 (gta6_fl_speed_bands). The others are reserve, for the reserve episodes (no turn on red, school zone, left lane). The Florida Move Over sign and the toll gantry sign are not in the list because no MUTCD number was confirmed: the discover queries look for them.
